image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a sliced meatloaf resting in a baking dish or on parchment paper. The loaf has a browned, textured exterior with a glossy, dark red glaze (likely ketchup or tomato-based) pooled in crevices and on top. Several slices have been cut, revealing a dense, coarse interior texture with visible flecks of ingredients. The lighting is warm, highlighting the moisture and grease on the surface.
